adjudication.reason: r1 produced measurable progress (Fmax 84.717 -> 109.302 MHz, WNS +2.655 ns) and moved the critical path from memory reads to a specific 13-level arithmetic chain. One targeted pipeline split is evidence-based, not blind synthesis trial.

result.note: G1 regression PASS on the new candidate; G2 synthesis WNS<0, so no route and no bitgen.

candidate_binding.rule: r2 creates a new derived candidate; never overwrite r0/r1 manifests or reports; never reuse old PASS for new hashes

scope.objective: Split the remaining 13-level arithmetic path between S_MLEN and S_MDIST (pos_next = pos + len_r, remaining = blk_n - pos_next, stored_bits compare, pos update / pos_reg[*].ce), then rerun G1 and make exactly one TD G2 attempt on the same small top at 187.5 MHz.
allowed_changes: minimal pipeline-only adaptation in upstream/ph1p100-pcie-ep-fpga/rtl/ep_side/codec/a1_frame_top.v if strictly required
forbidden_changes: external port/interface semantics, frame commit/abort/CRC/length behavior
format-v1.md, zlib wrapper, fixed+stored subset, Bayer mapping
187.5 MHz clock, SDC thresholds, false paths or multicycle exceptions
semantic_steps: 1. Insert one pipeline stage between S_MLEN and S_MDIST: register pos_next, remaining and stored_bits compare result; break dist_r -> pos_reg[*].ce across the stage.
2. Preserve match length/distance decisions, stored fallback choice, one-block-per-2-rows framing and external behavior; record cycle delta.
3. Rerun P2 13/13 + P3 20/20 on the new candidate; require 0 mismatch, vlog 0/0, no X; stop if any fails.
4. Run exactly one TD session (P4 session 4, final exception) on the same a1_eng_top and 187.5 MHz: synth first; only if WNS>=0 launch route; require Routed and WNS/TNS>=0 within 30 minutes.
5. Freeze CANDIDATE-MANIFEST-r2.json (new file), write p4/result-r2.md with routed WNS/TNS/resources/throughput and explicit PASS/FAIL; no bitgen/download.

gates.G1_regression: P2 13/13 + P3 20/20, 0 sample/byte mismatch, vlog 0/0, no X; must complete before TD.
gates.G2: TD exit=0; Confidence=Routed; SWNS/STNS/HWNS >= 0 (record values); 0 violations; resources within PH1P100SBG484; no broad false paths.
gates.throughput: recomputed from G1 cycles at 187.5 MHz; 1080p >= 77.76 MB/s required, 97.2 target; no theoretical substitution.
gates.evidence: r2 manifest with per-file SHA256 and 0 mismatches; raw logs; routed timing/area reports; independent tester report.

stop_conditions: Any P2/P3 regression mismatch, X propagation, or vlog error -> stop before TD.
After the RTL fix, if synthesis WNS < 0 -> stop; do not route, do not try another seed.
If route does not reach Routed within the single 30-minute session -> stop; no 5th session and no r3.
If G2 passes but throughput drops below 77.76 MB/s -> FAIL, no threshold change.
Any request to relax 187.5 MHz, SDC, or add false paths -> blocked, return evidence.
After r2, no further repair in this round regardless of outcome.

write_scope.rule: use -r2 names; never overwrite r0/r1 evidence

protected: all existing files outside the allowed codec dirs and the P4 run dir
production top, B01 bit/CWC, old runs, workflow/tasks.json
R10F contract, T03 enums, SDC files other than the P4 r2 copy

after_development.tester: one new independent integrated tester for T10.a1-eng-freeze r2
tester_must: bind the new r2 manifest and hashes
independently rerun P2 13/13 and P3 20/20 on the new candidate
verify routed G2 report, WNS/TNS, resources, and throughput recomputation
write test-reports/T10.a1-eng-freeze-r2-integrated.md with one unique verdict heading
after_development.on_pass: P4 PASS (G0/G1/G2 small top); T10 A+ offline closed loop established, but no G3/board/real-data claim.
after_development.on_fail: P4 remains WARN/blocked; round closes at 3/4 PASS + 1 WARN; no further repair this round.
